note: This corpus is the repo's own documentation. Anchors are verbatim prose substrings of the named source file after whitespace normalisation (checked by eval/corpora/verify_facts.py). Prose was preferred over table cells and fenced code because the docling markdown converter may reflow those.

facts.expected: There is no weighted linear blend
facts.summary: Hybrid fusion is pure RRF; there is no weighted linear blend and no dense_weight knob.

facts.expected: memoised in a 256-entry
facts.summary: The query embedding is memoised in a 256-entry lru_cache per retriever.

facts.expected: so requests are handled one at a time
facts.summary: The RAG API is a single-threaded TCPServer, so requests are handled one at a time.

facts.expected: Vector search is a brute-force scan
facts.summary: No ANN index is built, so vector search is an exhaustive scan.

facts.expected: Changing the embedding model requires re-indexing
facts.summary: Changing the embedding model requires re-indexing.

facts.expected: There are no inline citation markers
facts.summary: There are no inline citation markers; sources come back as source_documents.

facts.expected: the freshly added neighbours are filtered back out
facts.summary: When the reranker ran, context-expansion neighbours are filtered back out.

facts.expected: naver/provence-reranker-debertav3-v1
facts.summary: Sentence pruning uses naver/provence-reranker-debertav3-v1.

facts.expected: so pruning is off unless a request enables it
facts.summary: No shipped profile has a provence block, so pruning is off by default.

facts.expected: clamped to the first 4000 characters
facts.summary: The verifier prompt clamps context to the first 4000 characters.

facts.expected: There is exactly one call site in the repository
facts.summary: The verifier has exactly one call site.

facts.expected: one extra LLM round-trip per answered query
facts.summary: Verification costs one extra utility-model round-trip per answered query.

facts.expected: 0 is treated as a parse failure
facts.summary: A confidence score of 0 is treated as a parse failure and no tag is appended.

facts.expected: There is no regex or keyword stage in the agent
facts.summary: The agent router has no regex or keyword stage.

facts.expected: the first 40 loaded overviews
facts.summary: The overview router uses the first 40 loaded overviews.

facts.expected: There is no global triage on/off switch
facts.summary: There is no global triage on/off switch and no similarity threshold.

facts.expected: costs an LLM call, on the utility model
facts.summary: Only the agent-side router makes an LLM call (utility model qwen3.5:4b); the gateway gate is pure Python.

facts.expected: while the HTTP path always sends
facts.summary: The CLI path uses the 1500-token code default while the HTTP path always sends 512.

facts.expected: files bypass docling entirely and are wrapped in a fenced code block
facts.summary: .txt files bypass docling and are wrapped in a fenced code block.

facts.expected: the legacy path has no overlap logic at all
facts.summary: There is no chunk-overlap knob; the legacy chunker has no overlap logic.

facts.expected: produces 2560-dim vectors
facts.summary: Qwen3-Embedding-4B is 2560-dim, the 0.6B is 1024-dim; not interchangeable.

facts.expected: No ANN index is created
facts.summary: No ANN/IVF-PQ index is created anywhere in rag_system.

facts.expected: there is no thread or process pool anywhere in the indexing path
facts.summary: Indexing is sequential; batch size controls reporting and memory, not concurrency.

facts.expected: a summary shorter than 5 characters is discarded
facts.summary: An enrichment summary under 5 characters is discarded and the chunk is indexed unenriched.

facts.expected: truncated to 5000 characters
facts.summary: Overview input is the first N chunks truncated to 5000 characters.

facts.expected: roughly double the vectors written
facts.summary: Late chunking costs a second copy of the embedder and roughly double the vectors.

facts.expected: records the embedding model that wrote it
facts.summary: Each table records its embedding model + normalized flag; mismatch raises EmbedderMismatchError at index and query time.

facts.expected: Silently dropping or recreating an index would corrupt it
facts.summary: A dimension mismatch is a hard ValueError on purpose.

facts.expected: No prompt hard-codes a model name
facts.summary: No prompt hard-codes a model name; roles resolve through OLLAMA_CONFIG.

facts.expected: Two legacy example blocks still live in the file
facts.summary: Two legacy decomposition example blocks are present but excluded from the assembled prompt.

facts.expected: Caps the reply at 1-2 sentences
facts.summary: The direct_answer prompt caps the reply at 1-2 sentences.
